specification_compliance: Every backend file in the diff appears in the touch-point list: models.py, database.py, schemas.py, the new home_shortcuts.py, main.py, collections.py, drives.py and backend/tests/.

smart_folders.py is listed but unchanged. Its list, create and update handlers return ORM rows (smart_folders.py:62, :92, :117), and `SmartFolderResponse` uses `from_attributes`, so the new `SmartFolder.on_home` property fills `on_home` (I10) with no edit.

fileops._update_pinned_folders (fileops.py:534-551) rewrites `pinned_folders.path` in place with an UPDATE and leaves other columns alone. It does not delete and re-insert, so `home_added_at` carries through a rename or move (I8). This matches 'read, not changed'.

The migration (database.py:591-603) adds only a nullable DATETIME column per table, which follows .claude/rules/backend-conventions.md:46-49. The legacy playlists→collections copy (database.py:300) runs before it and names its columns explicitly, so new rows start NULL (I9). The cleanup block after it touches only collection_items.

There is no other backend construction of PinnedFolderResponse, CollectionDetailResponse or SmartFolderResponse outside the edited places, so the now-required `on_home` field cannot produce a 500 elsewhere.

Submodules (.gitmodules: addons/intelligence, knowledge, cloud-sync, media_import): none consumes /pins, /smart-folders or the public collection detail. The intelligence addon uses only the internal /api/internal/collections/{id}/file-ids endpoint, which is unchanged.
FolderContent and FolderTreePane are listed but unchanged. FolderBrowser passes isOnHome/onToggleHome to the toolbar directly, and FolderTreePane keeps using only pinnedPaths and handleTogglePin.

Frontend source files in the diff (api.ts, types, HomeAppEntries, DriveHome, FolderToolbar, usePinnedFolders, FolderBrowser, CollectionDetail, SmartFolderSaveButton, useSmartFolders, messages) are all listed.

The PUT is a single UPDATE … SET home_added_at = coalesce(home_added_at, now) filtered by drive and id. Two concurrent PUTs therefore cannot both stamp a fresh time, and a cross-drive id matches no row (I1, I3).
potential_unspecified_behavior: HomeAppEntries now wraps every tile label (built-in, addon and Inbox) in a span with line-clamp-2 / truncate and adds max-w-[16rem] at ≥36rem. Spec item 9 states this, but only I13's two long-label fixtures guard it. Existing short labels on built-in tiles are assumed to look unchanged and are not measured.
regression_risks: Any current or future vitest file that renders DriveHome with a strict `vi.mock("@/lib/api", () => ({…}))` factory lacking `getHomeShortcuts` now throws at loadPage. The eight known hosts were updated; I found no other strict host by grep, but I did not run the suite.

The MCP `get_collection` output shape gains `on_home`. Any MCP-side test asserting the exact output with toEqual against a backend payload that includes on_home would need updating. The current mcp tests use fixtures without it.
test_coverage: usePinnedFolders.test.ts is named in the touch list but unchanged. The hook's new `homePaths`, `handleToggleHome`, in-flight guard and the clearing of homePaths on pin/unpin have no unit test there. They are exercised only through FolderBrowser.homeShortcut.test.tsx, which runs the hook against a fetch stub. The existing hook test still works because useToast returns a no-op outside its provider and next-intl is mocked in src/test/setup.ts.
